sources.title: GOV.UK travel advice: Bermuda entry requirements
sources.officialityEvidence: GOV.UK publishes this current FCDO entry-requirements guidance and expressly scopes it to holders of a full British citizen passport travelling from the UK.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You can visit Bermuda without a visa for up to 180 days in any 12-month period.

sources.title: Immigration Rules Appendix Visitor: Visa national list
sources.officialityEvidence: GOV.UK publishes the Home Office Immigration Rules appendix, updated 3 August 2026, which Bermuda incorporates for marked schedule-country exceptions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A person who meets one or more of the criteria below needs entry clearance in advance of travel to the UK.

policies.title: Bermuda: full British-citizen passports visa-free for a short visit
policies.summary: Current UK government Bermuda guidance states that a holder of a full British citizen passport travelling from the UK may visit without a visa for up to 180 days in any 12-month period. This is visa-free, not an ETA, eVisa or visa-on-arrival route.
conditions: The UK source expressly limits this statement to people travelling on a full British citizen passport from the UK; it does not establish treatment for other British-national statuses or special British documents.
The stated limit is up to 180 days in any 12-month period and requires a return or onward ticket.
Work, study, business, residence, crew, transit, diplomatic, official, special-document, territory-belonger and individual-admission arrangements are excluded.
